reduction_law: The counting part of the squarefree Buchstab support problem is not the terminal obstruction: in any thick admitted balanced interval, Mertens/Buchstab gives interval/log^E many squarefree products, enough for the requested log-power support. The remaining obstruction is exactness: the canonical RIW layer must admit those products with nonzero coefficients, and intervals too thin for this argument must be forced back to an existing edge/PDEC/SAE exit.
review_conclusion: SquarefreeBuchstabLayerSupportLowerBound 的原始计数层已经被压下去：在厚的 surviving balanced interval 中，Mertens/Buchstab 型下界足以提供 log-power 级 squarefree product 支撑。真正剩余不再是“有没有足够 squarefree 数”，而是 exact canonical RIW/Buchstab 层是否承认这些 product 且系数非零；若区间太薄，则必须严格回到 edge/PDEC/SAE。
